other_conditions: Beneficiary must not own any house or house site anywhere in the state of Andhra Pradesh
Beneficiary must not have been covered in any previous housing scheme of the state or central government
Beneficiary must not have more than 2.5 acres of wet land or 5.0 acres of dry land
For urban beneficiaries, total household annual income must not exceed Rs.3,00,000
For rural beneficiaries, the household must belong to the identified Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
benefits_summary: Eligible households receive a house site patta (1.5 cents in rural areas, 1.0 cent in urban areas) and, for urban areas, a G+3 housing unit, both allocated in the name of the woman beneficiary.
